reason: Comprehensive review of the 2024 Annual Report (20-F) found no company-disclosed TAM figures. The document contains extensive discussion of business operations, therapeutic areas (oncology, cardiovascular, immunology, etc.), technology platforms (radioligand therapy, xRNA, gene therapy), and strategic priorities, but does not include any total addressable market size estimates or figures disclosed by Novartis itself. The filing focuses on commercial performance, pipeline, R&D strategy, and risk factors without quantifying market opportunity sizes.
